strings.zh: 你听过关于连接洞穴的歌谣吗？
strings.en: Have you heard the old{NEWLINE}rhyme about Union Cave?

strings.zh: 总感觉这段歌谣跟连接洞穴中{NEWLINE}栖息的神秘精灵有什么联系……
strings.en: I have a feeling that rhyme has{NEWLINE}something to do with the mysterious{CLEAR}Pokémon living in Union Cave...

strings.zh: 我听我奶奶唱过哦,{NEWLINE}大致内容是这样的：{SCROLL}鲜红的血液从地底渗出,{NEWLINE}照亮了最后的洞窟。{CLEAR}为红莲献上红心,{CLEAR}它就会从火焰中走来……{SCROLL}怎么样,这歌词是不是{NEWLINE}充满了神秘感呀？
strings.en: My grandma used to sing it.{NEWLINE}It goes something like this:{SCROLL}‘Crimson blood seeps up from the earth{NEWLINE}and lights the deepest cave. Offer a{CLEAR}red heart to the crimson lotus, and{CLEAR}it will walk forth from the flames...’{SCROLL}Well? Doesn’t that sound mysterious?
strings.notes: The Union Cave rhyme is the hack's own riddle (Heatran / Magma Stone hint), not a real song; translated.

strings.zh: 小豪『听说这个洞穴里{NEWLINE}有一只传说中的强大精灵,{CLEAR}我一定要找出它来然后一球抓住！
strings.en: Goh: I heard there’s a powerful{NEWLINE}legendary Pokémon in this cave. I’m{CLEAR}gonna find it and catch it with one ball!

strings.zh: 小豪『看什么看！{NEWLINE}有什么号幸灾乐祸的！{CLEAR}你要是不愿意帮忙就滚远点！
strings.en: Goh: What are you looking at?!{NEWLINE}Enjoying someone else’s bad luck?{CLEAR}If you won’t help, get lost!
strings.notes: zh typo 有什么号 read as 有什么好.

strings.zh: 班吉拉『Tyyy——ra！
strings.en: Tyranitar: Tyyy-ra!

strings.zh: 超音蝠『Zuuuu——ba！
strings.en: Zubat: Zuuuu-ba!

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……我的玛力露被抢走了……
strings.en: *sob sob*... Someone stole my Marill...
